actions.description: Create an issue for a team.
actions.name: create-issue

actions.description: Create a milestone linked to a rock
actions.name: create-milestone

rockId.description: The ID of the Rock to link the milestone to. Example: "6a6175355346be5d56149d93"

title.description: The title of the milestone. Example: "Complete phase 1"

dueDate.description: The due date of the milestone in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-12-31T00:00:00Z"

teamId.description: The ID of the team the milestone belongs to. Example: "6a616ba8908190d6d9458153"

completedDate.description: The completion date in ISO 8601 format. Required when isDone is true.

actions.description: Create a rock assigned to the authenticated user.
actions.name: create-rock

teamId.description: Team ID to assign the rock to. Example: "6a616ba8908190d6d9458153"

dueDate.description: Due date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-12-31T00:00:00Z"

assigneeIds.description: User IDs to assign the rock to.

actions.description: Create a to-do (personal or team-based).
actions.name: create-todo

title.description: The title of the to-do. Example: "Follow up with client"

teamId.description: Team ID to assign the to-do to. If omitted, creates a personal to-do. Example: "6a616ba8908190d6d9458153"

actions.description: Permanently delete an issue.
actions.name: delete-issue

issueId.description: The unique identifier of the issue to delete. Example: "6a6174eeec1cad4577a10b9a"

actions.description: Soft-delete a rock.
actions.name: delete-rock

actions.description: Delete a measurable's note for a period.
actions.name: delete-scorecard-note

kpiId.description: The ID of the KPI. Example: "6a616ba843cee8f7e09d7e31"

periodStartDate.description: The period start date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"

actions.description: Delete a measurable's score for a period.
actions.name: delete-scorecard-score

kpiId.description: The ID of the KPI whose score should be deleted. Example: "6a616ba843cee8f7e09d7e31"

periodStartDate.description: The ISO 8601 start date of the period whose score should be deleted. Must exactly match the date used when the score was created. Example: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"

actions.description: Delete a to-do.
actions.name: delete-todo

actions.description: Retrieve a single issue by id.
actions.name: get-issue

issueId.description: The unique identifier of the issue. Example: "6a68fb4f2f9e9442985c809d"

actions.description: Retrieve a single milestone by id.
actions.name: get-milestone

actions.description: Retrieve a single rock by id.
actions.name: get-rock

id.description: The unique identifier of the rock. Example: "6a61d2d0441c43ad0eaabd3c"

actions.description: Retrieve a single to-do by id.
actions.name: get-todo

actions.description: Retrieve a single user by id.
actions.name: get-user

actions.description: Query issues with filtering by team, interval, and search text.
actions.name: list-issues

team.description: Team ID to filter by. Example: "6a616ba8908190d6d9458153"

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. Example: 10

actions.description: Query rocks grouped by team with filtering and pagination.
actions.name: list-rocks

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (0-200). Example: 50

actions.description: Query measurables (KPIs) with filtering.
actions.name: list-scorecard-kpis

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page index). Omit for the first page.

searchText.description: Free-text search over title and description.

excludeKpiIds.description: Exclude specific KPI IDs from results.

periodInterval.description: Filter by period interval (e.g., Annual, Quarterly).

sortField.description: Field to sort by (e.g., id, owner, title).

actions.description: List teams visible to the authenticated user.
actions.name: list-teams

actions.description: Query to-dos (personal or team-based) with filtering options.
actions.name: list-todos

teamId.description: Filter results to a specific team Id. Example: "6a616ba8908190d6d9458153"

sort.description: The field to sort results by. Example: "dueDate"

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (max 100). Example: 25

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (page number) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

isPersonal.description: Filter to personal To-Dos only (not associated with a team)

searchText.description: Search text to match against To-Do title and description

followers.description: Array of user IDs to set as followers
